details: Move the nested private interface 'SerializableSupplier<T>' out of DiffBuilder into a package-level interface SerializableSupplier<T> in org.apache.commons.lang3.builder. The new top-level interface will preserve the same contract: it extends java.util.function.Supplier<T> and java.io.Serializable. Make it package-private (no explicit modifier) so it does not broaden the public API beyond the package.
